record.where: The ecosystem (v3.27 — utilities ride the pack, works hold the ground, the loop revolves)

clauses.text: the two shelves + loop lines
The terminal's Fabricate sheet opens on the split, named in the register's voice — UTILITIES (what rides the pack)
with the loop law printed at the counter and a ↻ loop line per item saying what it eats and what it feeds
the build bar's works
WORKS (what holds the ground, via kits and B)
LUMEN STILL (metal 14 + ceramic 6)

figure.note: the bar's card reads 14 metal + 6 ceramic

clauses.text: SAWCAMP (metal 10 + wood 4)

figure.note: the bar's card reads 10 metal + 4 wood

clauses.text: CLAY OVEN (metal 8 + wood 6)

figure.note: the bar's card reads 8 metal + 6 wood

clauses.text: all three siting laws honest on the one-truth path AND the build path with the kit kept
Three new production works, each SITED by terrain (the factory floor is geography, and the ghost is honest about a bad site BEFORE the kit is spent)
Systems.workInfo/workState is the ONE truth read by the tick, the ledger and the labels
wants the VEIL thick at its site (mistBase ≥ 0.22: the light's edge, not its heart)

figure.note: the sites are read against DATA.T.stillMist (0.22 in src/12_data.js), not against 0.22

clauses.text: wants a treeline in reach (240)

figure.note: the forest is sought within DATA.T.sawReach (240 in src/12_data.js); the reach itself is not asserted

clauses.text: wants wet ground close (marsh/shallows within 160)

figure.note: the good and the bad sites come from the one truth itself; the 160 reach is not asserted

clauses.text: production paying bank/lifetime/tally/chip
Every unit LANDS as an earn chip labeled by its work, with a puff at the site and a first-pay tutorial
pays 1 wood / 75 s

figure.note: the clock is set 0.8 s short of DATA.T.sawRate and exactly 1 wood lands; the 75 s itself is not asserted

clauses.text: the storm doubling the still
GREY WEATHER RUNS IT AT DOUBLE — the storm is a harvest

figure.note: the same twelve seconds run the still's clock ×2 (to 0.01) in grey weather

clauses.text: pays 1 lumen / 90 s

figure.note: the clock is set 0.6 s short of DATA.T.stillRate and exactly 1 lumen lands in the grey; the 90 s itself is not asserted

clauses.text: the mutual synergy at ×1.25 measured both ways

figure.note: the axe's clock and the saw's clock each run ×1.25 (to 0.01), and the tuning reads 1.25

clauses.text: disrepair freezing the clock
DISREPAIR (hp < 30) pauses hands — the clock holds, nothing pays

figure.note: the oven is set 3 under DATA.T.workHpMin (30 in src/12_data.js); the line itself is not asserted

clauses.text: and repair costs 5 metal: the loop feeding back

figure.note: E at the oven takes exactly 5 metal from the bank

clauses.text: pays 1 ceramic / 85 s

figure.note: the repaired oven's held clock (2 s short of DATA.T.ovenRate) pays exactly 1 slab; the 85 s itself is not asserted

clauses.text: tithe and rack with the honest no-meadow state
the watchtower's armed post sweeps the SPOTTER'S TITHE (1 metal / 110 s)

figure.note: the tithe's rate is compared with DATA.T.titheRate and 1 metal lands; the 110 s itself is not asserted

clauses.text: the shelter's room hangs a DRYING RACK (1 provisions / 120 s where meadow grows in reach — and says NO MEADOW IN REACH instead of paying where none does)

figure.note: the rack's rate is compared with DATA.T.rackRate and 1 provision lands; the 120 s itself is not asserted

clauses.text: the ledger block
The station Ledger tab's [ THE ECOSYSTEM ] block lists every producing work
rate, lifetime pay, percent mended — and the all-works, all-time tally from S.eco.produced
the closed loop
Every banked resource now has an automated, sited source

checks.title: THE DRYING RACK, AND THE HONEST NO

design.what: the plain names: the station's Ledger tab is the terminal's Records tab; the ecosystem block stands in it
